paite: Huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, David tapa Absalom in sanggam numei melhoih khat anei a, amin Tamar ahi. David tapa Amnon in amah a-it hi.
heading: Ammon Leh Tamar
english: After this, Absalom the son of David had a beautiful sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.

paite: Huchi in asanggamnu Tamar ziak in Amnon abuai mahmah a; achi ana hi. Amah lah nungak siangthou ahih ziak in atung a thil banghiam hih haksapi ahi chi in Amnon in angaihtuah hi.
english: Amnon was so troubled that he became sick because of his sister Tamar, for she was a virgin, and it seemed hard to Amnon to do anything to her.

paite: Himahleh Amnon in lawm anei a, amin Jonadab ahi. Amah David unaupa Shimea tapa ahi. Jonadab migitlouhpil mahmah mi khat ahi.
english: But Amnon had a friend whose name was Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother; and Jonadab was a very subtle man.

paite: Ama'n Amnon kiang ah, "Aw, nang kumpipa tapa bangchidan ahia, aniteng a na gawn hulhul mawk? Hon hilh lou ding maw?" achi hi. Amnon in akiang ah, "Ka unaupa Absalom sanggamnu Tamar ka it a ahi," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Why, son of the king, are you so sad from day to day? Won’t you tell me?” Amnon said to him, “I love Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister.”

paite: Jonadab in akiang ah, "Na lupna ah lumlum inla, kichinasak in. Na pa'n ahong veh chiang in akiang ah, Hehpih in ka sanggamnu Tamar ka kiang ah hong hoh henla, tanghou nek ding hong pia hen. Ka muh theih in ka mitmuh mahmah in nek ding hon bawlsakleh, akhut ngei ah ka na ne ding, na chi in," achi hi.
english: Jonadab said to him, “Lay down on your bed and pretend to be sick. When your father comes to see you, tell him, ‘Please let my sister Tamar come and give me bread to eat, and prepare the food in my sight, that I may see it and eat it from her hand.’”

paite: Huchi in Amnon alum a, akichinasakta hi. Kumpipa'n amah ava et in Amnon in akiang ah, "Hehpih in ka sanggamnu Tamar hong pai henla, ka mitmuh mahmah in tanghou pek nih hiam hon bawlsak henla, amah khut mahmah ah ka ne ding," achi hi.
english: So Amnon lay down and faked being sick. When the king came to see him, Amnon said to the king, “Please let my sister Tamar come and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat from her hand.”

paite: Huchi in David in Tamar kiang ah, "Na sanggampa Amnon inn ah hoh inla, nek ding va bawlsak dih ve," chi ding in a-inn ah mi asawl hi.
english: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, “Go now to your brother Amnon’s house, and prepare food for him.”

paite: Huchi in Tamar, asanggampa Amnon inn ah ahoh hi. Amah ana lum hi. Tangbuang ala a, amek a, amitmuh a tanghou pek bawl in akang hi.
english: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house; and he was lying down. She took dough, kneaded it, made cakes in his sight, and baked the cakes.

paite: Akanna bel ala a, ama ah abungkhia hi. Himahleh ama'n ane nuam kei hi. Huan Amnon in, "Mi tengteng in hon pawtkhiaksan uhen," achi hi. Huchi in apawtkhiaksan vek uhi.
english: She took the pan and poured them out before him, but he refused to eat. Amnon said, “Have all men leave me.” Then every man went out from him.

paite: Huan Amnon in Tamar kiang ah, "Na khut mahmah a ka nektheihna ding in nek ding dantan ah hon la in," achi hi. Tamar in atanghou pek bawl ala a, asanggampa Amnon kiang ah dantan ah alalut hi.
english: Amnon said to Tamar, “Bring the food into the room, that I may eat from your hand.” Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the room to Amnon her brother.

paite: Nesak dia akiangnai a ava paipih in ana len a, akiang ah, "Ka sanggamnu, ka kiang ah hong lum in," achi hi.
english: When she had brought them near to him to eat, he took hold of her and said to her, “Come, lie with me, my sister!”

paite: Ama'n adawng a, "Hilou e, ka sanggampa, hon chi teitei ke'n. Israelte lak ah hichibang thilhih ding ahi kei. Hiai thil gilou haihuaitak hih ke'n.
english: She answered him, “No, my brother, do not force me! For no such thing ought to be done in Israel. Don’t you do this folly!

paite: Ke'n ka maizumna koi ah ka paisak dia? Nang leng Israelte lak a mihaite lak a khat na hi ding. Huaiziak in tu in kumpipa houpih zaw in, na hon neih anial kei ding," achi hi.
english: As for me, where would I carry my shame? And as for you, you will be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, please speak to the king; for he will not withhold me from you.”

paite: Himahleh athu azui kei a, amah sang in ahatzaw ngal a, thagum in akithuahpih teiteita hi.
english: However, he would not listen to her voice; but being stronger than she, he forced her and lay with her.

paite: Huchi in Amnon in huat chihtak in ahota a, a-itna sang in ahuatna alianzaw hi. Huchi in Amnon in akiang ah, "Thou inla, paimang in," achi hi.
english: Then Amnon hated her with exceedingly great hatred; for the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he had loved her. Amnon said to her, “Arise, be gone!”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Huchi ding ahi kei. Hichibang a dikloutak a na hon delhkhiak ka tung a na gamtatsa sang in ahoih kei zaw hi,” achi hi. Himahleh azui nuam tuan kei hi.
english: She said to him, “Not so, because this great wrong in sending me away is worse than the other that you did to me!” But he would not listen to her.

paite: Huchi in anasem sikha asam a, "Hiai numei ka kiang a pan pawtsak inla, kong khak bikbek in," achi hi.
english: Then he called his servant who ministered to him, and said, “Now put this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.”

paite: Minu'n puanaktual ze tuamtuam a gial asilh hi. Huchibang puanaktual kumpipa nungak siangthoute'n asilh uh ahi. Huchi in asikha in apikhia a, kong akhak bikbekta hi.
english: She had a garment of various colors on her, for the king’s daughters who were virgins dressed in such robes. Then his servant brought her out and bolted the door after her.

paite: Tamar in alu ah meivu akoih a, apuanaktual silh ze tuamtuam abotkek a, asip ah akhut akoih a, ngaihtak a kap kawm in apaita hi.
english: Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore her garment of various colors that was on her; and she laid her hand on her head and went her way, crying aloud as she went.

paite: Asanggampa Absalom in akiang ah, "Na sanggampa Amnon na kiang a om ahi maw? Himahleh tu in dai mai in, ka sanggamnu, na sanggampa aka, limsak dah in," achi hi. Huchi in Tamar asanggampa Absalom inn ah nguitak in akikhumta hi.
english: Absalom her brother said to her, “Has Amnon your brother been with you? But now hold your peace, my sister. He is your brother. Don’t take this thing to heart.” So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom’s house.

paite: Himahleh kumpipa David in huai tengteng azak in aheh mahmah hi.
english: But when King David heard of all these things, he was very angry.

paite: Absalom in Amnon kiang ah asia-apha hitaleh bangmah agen nuam kei hi. Asanggamnu Tamar achih teitei ziak in Absalom in Amnon aho mahmah hi.
english: Absalom spoke to Amnon neither good nor bad; for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.

paite: Kum nih vengveng abei nung in hichi ahong hi a, Ephraim kiang a Baal-hazor ah Absalom in belam mul ametsak hi. Hiai ah kumpipa tapa tengteng achial hi.
heading: Absalom Phulakna
english: After two full years, Absalom had sheep shearers in Baal Hazor, which is beside Ephraim; and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.

paite: Kumpipa kiang ah Absalom ahoh a, “Ngai in, na sikha in belam mul ametsak a, kumpipa leh asikhate na sikha kiang ah hoh le uh akei dia,” achi hi.
english: Absalom came to the king and said, “See now, your servant has sheep shearers. Please let the king and his servants go with your servant.”

paite: Kumpipa'n Absalom kiang ah, "Hilou e, ka tapa, ka vek un hoh lou e, ka hon hihtuailuai lo kha ding uh," achi hi. Huchi in ama'n chial teitei mahleh a-ut tuan kei a, himahleh avualzawl hi.
english: The king said to Absalom, “No, my son, let’s not all go, lest we be burdensome to you.” He pressed him; however he would not go, but blessed him.

paite: Huchi in Absalom in, “Ahihkeileh ka unaupa Amnon bek ka kiang uah hong hohleh ake," achi hi. Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Bang ding in ahong hoh tuamse dia?" achi hi.
english: Then Absalom said, “If not, please let my brother Amnon go with us.” The king said to him, “Why should he go with you?”

paite: Himahleh Absalom in angen teitei a, huchi in Amnon leh kumpipa tapa tengteng azuisak hi.
english: But Absalom pressed him, and he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.

paite: Absalom in, asikhate kiang ah, "Ngai un, Amnon uain dawn a nuam asak lai in na kiang ua Amnon that un, ka hon chihleh, that unla, lau kei un, thu ka hon pe khin hilou hia? Hangsantak in om unla, kipasalsak un," chi in thu apia hi.
english: Absalom commanded his servants, saying, “Mark now, when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine; and when I tell you, ‘Strike Amnon,’ then kill him. Don’t be afraid. Haven’t I commanded you? Be courageous, and be valiant!”

paite: Huchi in Absalom sikhate'n Amnon tung ah Absalom thupiak bang in ahih uhi. Huchi in kumpipa tapa tengteng athou ua, asabiltung uah atuang chiat ua, ataimangta uhi.
english: The servants of Absalom did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons arose, and every man got up on his mule and fled.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, lampi a a-om lai un, Absalom in kumpipa tapate tengteng athat vek a, khat lel leng ahawi kei, chi in David kiang ah thu ana tung hi.
english: While they were on the way, the news came to David, saying, “Absalom has slain all the king’s sons, and there is not one of them left!”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa athou a apuansilhte botkek in lei ah alumta hi. Asikha tengteng in leng apuansilhte uh botkek in akiang ah adingh uhi.
english: Then the king arose, and tore his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes torn.

paite: David unau Shimea tapa Jonadab in adawng a, "Ka toupa'n kumpipa tapa tangval tengteng athat vek uh chih gingta kei hen. Amnon kia ahi asi. Asanggamnu Tamar achih teitei nungsiah Absalom in hichibang a hih atup him ahi.
english: Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother, answered, “Don’t let my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men, the king’s sons, for Amnon only is dead; for by the appointment of Absalom this has been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in ka toupa, kumpipa'n kumpipa tapa tengteng asi uh chih gingta in lunghimoh kei hen. Amnon kia ahi asi," achi hi.
english: Now therefore don’t let my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead; for only Amnon is dead.”

paite: Huai sung in Absalom ataimangta hi. Galvil tangval adak a, a-en a, ngai in, anunglam a tang pang a lampi ah mi tampi ahong pai uhi.
english: But Absalom fled. The young man who kept the watch lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, many people were coming by way of the hillside behind him.

paite: Jonadab in kumpipa kiang ah, “Ngai in, kumpipa tapate ahong pai uh, na sikha in agen bang geih ana hi na," achi hi.
english: Jonadab said to the king, “Behold, the king’s sons are coming! It is as your servant said.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, agen khittak in ngai in, kumpipa tapate ahong tung ua, a-aw uh suah in akap uhi. Kumpipa leng asikhate toh kah petmah in akapta uhi.
english: As soon as he had finished speaking, behold, the king’s sons came, and lifted up their voices and wept. The king also and all his servants wept bitterly.

paite: Himahleh Absalom ataimang a, Geshur kumpipa Ammihud tapa Talmai kiang ah ahoh hi. David in niteng in atapa asuun hi.
english: But Absalom fled and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur, king of Geshur. David mourned for his son every day.

paite: Absalom ataimang a, Geshur gam atung a, huai ah kum thum ava om hi.
english: So Absalom fled and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

paite: Absalom kiang ah kumpipa David hoh a-ut mahmah a, Amnon tungtang thu ah alung amuangta hi. Amah lah asi khinta chih athei ngal a.
english: King David longed to go out to Absalom, for he was comforted concerning Amnon, since he was dead.
